messages:
maria-cs: Orbital asks for a short demo window across EU + APAC in ~90m. Need ephemeral QPS bump and two edge CIDR entries for demo infra, ~30m.
orbital-pm: Demo at 16:10 UTC. CIDRs: 203.0.113.128/28 and 198.51.100.112/28. Prefer routing pinned to eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1. We'll restart clients 5m prior.
maria-cs: Request: 1) per-region QPS x4, 2) add edge CIDRs, 3) routing override for new connections, auto-revoke after 35m. Capture for renewal notes (they're trialing committed capacity).
jin-sre: I can run this. I'll create CR-9912 and set TTL 40m (buffer). Plan: apply allowlist on edges, set QPS multiplier x4 for eu & apac, routing tag orbital-demo-9912. No control-plane changes.
devrel: Recommend enabling a 4m prefix KV cache on /v1/generate to smooth token spikes during the demo.
orbital-pm: Cache ok, client restart confirmed.
jin-sre: Runbook (short): ```
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=orbital --cidr=203.0.113.128/28 --reason="demo-9912"
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=orbital --cidr=198.51.100.112/28 --reason="demo-9912"
redwoodctl quota set --customer=orbital --region=eu-west-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=40m
redwoodctl quota set --customer=orbital --region=ap-southeast-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=40m
redwoodctl routing override --customer=orbital --preferred-regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --tag=orbital-demo-9912 --expires-in=40m
redwoodctl cache set --customer=orbital --scope="/v1/generate" --type=prefix --ttl=4m --expires-in=40m
```
sec-bot: Sec review: edge CIDRs approved for ephemeral demo window. No control-plane exceptions.
deploy-bot: Applying CR-9912 -> logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/CR-9912
deploy-bot: apply: edge-allowlist/orbital -> success (203.0.113.128/28), success (198.51.100.112/28) | quotas/orbital -> success (eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) | routing/override -> success | cache/kv -> success
maria-cs: Thanks everyone 134. I'll note this in the account health record and flag a renewal follow-up next week if demos look good. Jin, please post revoke event when TTL expires.
jin-sre: CR-9912 created and monitoring enabled. Auto-revoke scheduled in 40m at epoch 3801235420. Will manual rollback if they finish early.
